title: VAULT: Vision-Aware Unified Layer for safe Traversal
description: Research artifact for the ACSOS 2026 paper "When Should a Robot Stop Learning and Start Reasoning?". VAULT is a vision-based runtime safety framework that combines a learned navigation policy (NoMaD), monocular metric depth (Depth Anything V2), and a classical reactive avoider (VFH*) on a TurtleBot4 under ROS 2 Humble. The artifact includes the real-robot deployment code, a Webots simulation of the same pipeline, and the evaluation harness that reproduces the safety comparison between VAULT and the learned-only baseline.
